'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tom Hollingworth DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingworth]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Username:''' Wyethassellu(?)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
